recent_articles.title: Rajasthan Cabinet approves new industrial development policy with focus on talent economy - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Rajasthan** Cabinet approved a new industrial development policy focused on talent economy and private sector participation to create a world-class industrial infrastructure.  **Industries and Commerce Minister Rajyavardhan Singh Rathore** stated the policy would provide incentives for micro, small, and medium enterprises, one district one product, and the export sector. The policy aims to boost the state's economy to $350 billion by 2028-29.  The Cabinet also approved decisions on energy production, water conservation, and pensioners' welfare.

recent_articles.title: Slow-moving bands of heavy rain trigger flooding and landslides in parts of China | China | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Heavy rainfall across southern and central China has led to flash flooding, landslides, and waterlogging. The **Bay of Bengal**, **South China Sea**, and **Pacific Ocean** contributed to the prolonged downpour that caused 12 deaths and forced evacuations.  Meanwhile, extreme heat warnings have been issued for northern India, with temperatures exceeding 40°C (104°F) in several regions. These conditions are expected to persist until Wednesday when thunderstorms may develop.

recent_articles.title: Indigenous Vayu Astra-1 completes high-altitude trials in Uttarakhand, Pokhran - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Nibe Limited**, a Pune-based defense technology firm, successfully completed no-cost, no-commitment demonstrations of its indigenous loitering munition system ‘Vayu Astra-1’ for the **Indian Army**. The demonstrations were conducted in April at Pokhran in Rajasthan and Joshimath (Malari) in Uttarakhand.  The anti-personnel variant of Vayu Astra-1 demonstrated a 10-kg warhead strike at a range of 100 km with a CEP of less than one meter, achieving an abort attack and reattack capability during the trials.

recent_articles.title: Voter confusion fears over simultaneous polls ‘misplaced’, says ONOE JPC chairman - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **P.P. Chaudhary**, chairman of the Joint Parliamentary Committee on ‘One Nation One Election’, defended the proposal, arguing that Indian voters are politically astute and can differentiate between national and state issues.  He cited examples from Delhi and other states where voters supported different parties in Lok Sabha and Assembly elections. **CII**, **ASSOCHAM**, and **GCCI** backed the proposal, while **Gujarat University Vice-Chancellor Dr. Neerja Gupta** highlighted how frequent polls disrupt academic schedules and increase financial costs. The committee also heard concerns from the **Congress**, which argued that simultaneous elections would allow national narratives to overshadow state issues.

recent_articles.title: Congress workers clash with police in Jaipur during stir against NEET-UG paper leak - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** party workers clashed with **police** in **Rajasthan** on Thursday during a protest against the NEET-UG exam paper leak.  Led by **State Congress president Govind Singh Dotasra**, the protesters demanded the resignation of **Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan** and the dissolution of the **National Testing Agency**. The demonstrators, carrying banners and placards, were forcibly dispersed using water cannons. Some protesters suffered minor injuries.

recent_articles.title: NEET paper leak row: Congress demands resignation of Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** leaders demanded the resignation of **Dharmendra Pradhan**, the **Union Education Minister**, over the NEET-UG paper leak scandal.  They accused the government of a "money-making racket" involving people linked to the ruling establishment and claimed that the incident had caused immense trauma for 22 lakh students. **Rahul Gandhi** called for the Prime Minister's intervention, while **Mallikarjun Kharge**, the Congress president, alleged that the Modi government was undermining student credibility through repeated paper leaks.  **Jairam Ramesh**, a Congress general secretary, criticized the government's lack of action and incompetence in addressing exam reforms.

recent_articles.title: CBI arrests ‘mastermind’ linked to NEET-UG 2026 biology paper leak - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI)** arrested a biology lecturer, **Manisha Gurunath Mandhare**, for her involvement in the 2026 NEET-UG paper leak case.  **Mandhare**, appointed by the **National Testing Agency (NTA)** as an expert, allegedly disclosed questions and answers from botany and zoology subjects to students through special coaching classes at her residence. The agency has arrested nine individuals in connection with the case, including a chemistry lecturer, **P.V. Kulkarni**, who allegedly leaked chemistry questions.  The CBI is conducting searches across the country and investigating leads related to the distribution of a "guess" paper that closely matched the actual exam paper.

recent_articles.title: Rajasthan seeks permanent membership in Bhakra Beas Management Board - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rajasthan** Water Resources Minister Suresh Singh Rawat called for permanent membership in the **Bhakra Beas Management Board (BBMB)**, arguing that Rajasthan's 52.96% share of Ravi-Beas waters necessitates representation on the board.  Rawat emphasized the need for expedited decisions regarding water storage and utilization of advanced technologies like floating solar and pumped storage power plants. He also urged for increased transparency in water distribution through real-time monitoring, automated gauging systems, and online data sharing. The call was made during a 50th anniversary celebration of the BBMB in Panchkula, Haryana, attended by Union Minister Manohar Lal Khattar, Punjab Water Resources Minister Barinder Kumar Goyal, Haryana Irrigation and Water Resources Minister Shruti Choudhary, and BBMB chairman Manoj Tripathi.

recent_articles.title: Petrol and diesel prices hike LIVE: Government hikes price by ₹3 per litre, Congress lashes out - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Oil-marketing companies** increased petrol and diesel prices by ₹3 across all variants on Friday, May 15, 2026, in response to pressure on fuel supplies due to the ongoing West Asia conflict. **The Centre** implemented this price hike nationwide, affecting both regular and premium petrol and diesel products, as well as high-octane options. Petrol prices rose to ₹97.77 per litre in Delhi and ₹107.97 per litre in Jaipur, while diesel prices climbed to ₹90.67 per litre in Delhi and ₹93.23 per litre in Jaipur.

recent_articles.title: MoS Arjun Ram Meghwal takes e-rickshaw ride in Rajasthan’s Bikaner to promote fuel conservation - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Arjun Ram Meghwal**, Union Minister of State for Law and Justice, traveled to his residence in Bikaner by e-rickshaw on Thursday to promote fuel conservation.  He joined **Prime Minister Narendra Modi's** call for austerity measures amidst global energy crises. Rajasthan Chief Minister **Bhajanlal Sharma** has also reduced the number of vehicles in his convoy.

recent_articles.title: NSUI holds protest outside Education Minister’s residence over NEET paper leak - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Members of the National Students’ Union of India (NSUI)** protested outside **Dharmendra Pradhan's** residence in Delhi, demanding his resignation following allegations of a paper leak in the NEET-UG 2026 examination. The protesters accused the Education Minister of failing to protect students and demanded a Supreme Court-monitored investigation into the incident, along with action against those involved. **The National Testing Agency (NTA)** cancelled the exam and announced it would be retaken at a later date.

recent_articles.title: SC asks Centre to consider States’ pleas for funds for CCTVs in police stations - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Supreme Court** urged the **Union government** to fully implement the Assistance to States and Union Territories for Modernisation of Police (ASUMP) scheme, which provides funds for installing CCTV cameras in police stations and a centralized monitoring dashboard. The court expressed concerns over non-functional CCTV cameras in Udaipur police stations and directed the Centre to consider requests from states for funding.  The ASUMP scheme has been extended until September 30, 2026, with most states initiating steps towards compliance. However, Jharkhand was criticized for not installing any CCTV cameras, despite receiving funds under the scheme. The court also cautioned against releasing funds without due diligence to prevent misappropriation.

recent_articles.title: PM austerity appeal: State leaders take steps to limit their fuel use - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, **Union Home Minister Amit Shah**, and several other state chief ministers have implemented measures to reduce fuel consumption in response to the West Asia crisis.  These include reducing convoy sizes, promoting electric vehicles, and encouraging public transport use. **Yogi Adityanath**, **Rekha Gupta**, **Mohan Yadav**, and others have also taken steps to promote sustainability within their respective states.  **Devendra Fadnavis**, **Harsh Sanghavi**, and **Acharya Devvrat** have implemented similar measures in Maharashtra, Gujarat, and Bihar respectively.

recent_articles.title: AICC begins consultations with Kerala leaders in New Delhi to decide on Congress’ CM candidate - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Gandhi**, **Sonia Gandhi**, and **Mallikarjun Kharge** met with top Kerala leaders in New Delhi on Tuesday to discuss the selection of a Chief Minister nominee for the state. The high command is seeking bipartisan support from former KPCC presidents, Congress MLAs-elect, and other key figures to restore organizational stability after the party's recent victory.  The meeting considered several potential candidates, including **K.C. Venugopal**, **V.D. Satheesan**, **Ramesh Chennithala**, and **Priyanka Gandhi Vadra**.  **K. Muraleedharan**, a KPCC insider, stated that the high command would consider popular opinion in addition to legislative party numbers when making their decision.

recent_articles.title: NEET-UG examination 2026: One suspect arrested from Nashik - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The National Testing Agency (NTA)** cancelled the NEET-UG examination for 2026 after an alleged paper leak, leading to the arrest of a suspect in **Maharashtra**. The Rajasthan Police requested the **Maharashtra police** to detain the individual who was apprehended after changing his appearance.  The cancellation has drawn criticism from opposition leaders, including **Rohit Pawar**, who pointed out that the state government's new law against paper leaks is insufficient and called for stricter action against those involved. A CBI inquiry into the matter has been initiated.

recent_articles.title: NEET-UG 2026 cancelled LIVE: CBI to probe paper leak allegations - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The National Testing Agency (NTA)** cancelled the NEET-UG 2026 exam held on May 3rd after allegations of a paper leak. The decision follows investigations by both the **Rajasthan Special Operations Group** and the **CBI**, with the government approving the cancellation to ensure transparency.  The examination will be re-conducted at a later date, details of which will be announced separately.

recent_articles.title: NSUI protests after NTA cancels NEET-UG 2026 over paper leak - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A massive protest organized by the **National Students' Union of India (NSUI)** erupted outside the **Shastri Bhawan** on Tuesday, May 12, 2026, demanding justice for students alleging a paper leak in the NEET-UG exam.  The protest saw members of the **Congress party's student wing** participate, holding signs and slogans criticizing the government's handling of the situation. The **National Testing Agency (NTA)** canceled the examination following investigations by the **Rajasthan Special Operations Group (SOG) and the CBI**.  The NSUI accused the central government of failing to protect students and demanded the resignation of **Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan** and a ban on the **NTA**.
